Create an SQL database with spectral data, feature data, and experiment metadata

Authors

Ahlam Mentag

Johannes Rainer

Rebecca Dauwe

Introduction

This Quarto document describes the workflow used to create an SQL database containing spectral data, feature data, and experiment metadata for the FTMS negative-mode flax dataset.

Required packages

library(Spectra)
library(xcms)
library(MsExperiment)
library(CompoundDb)
library(RSQLite)
library(S4Vectors) 
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
register(SerialParam())

Input data and directory structure

The working directory must be set to the root of the project. From this root directory, a subdirectory named data/ is required. This directory contains Spectra objects generated upstream by the Quarto documents:

  • ftms_filtering.qmd
  • ftms_assembled.qmd

The Project directory structure is as follows:

root/
├── ftms_filtering.qmd
├── ftms_assembled.qmd
├── ftms_ftmsneg_flax_sql.qmd
└── data/
    ├── ftms_assembled.RData
    └── ftms_one_merged_tree.RData

The following data files must be present:

  • data/ftms_assembled.RData
    Contains a Spectra object with one merged pseudo-MS² spectrum per feature of the flax experiment.

  • data/ftms_one_merged_tree.RData
    Contains a Spectra object with one assembled spectral tree per feature of the flax experiment.

All file paths used in this document are relative to the project root directory.

Verify working directory

# Verify working directory
pth <- getwd()
pth
[1] "D:/RDynLib_ftms"

Loading the data

# Load Spectra objects
load("data/ftms_assembled.RData")
load("data/ftms_one_merged_tree.RData")
spectraData(ftms_one_merged_tree)$spectrum.type <- "not_assembled"
df <- spectraData(ftms_assembled)
df[is.na(df$msLevel), ]
DataFrame with 0 rows and 47 columns

Concatenating Spectra objects

We concatenate the spectral tree and pseudo-MS² spectra generated above. First switch the storage backend of the Spectra objects to in-memory backend, which allows Efficient access to the spectral data since some backends may not support direct concatenation. Then combine them into a single Spectra object ftms_all The peaks and metadata of the concatenated spectra are then displayed for inspection.

library(Spectra)

ftms_one_merged_tree <- setBackend(ftms_one_merged_tree,  MsBackendMemory())
ftms_assembled <- setBackend(ftms_assembled,  MsBackendMemory())

# Concatenate
ftms_all <- concatenateSpectra(ftms_one_merged_tree, ftms_assembled)

save(ftms_all, file = "data/ftms_all.RData")

Create SQLite Database for FTMS Spectra

We create a new SQLite database to store the FTMS spectra for the flax negative-ion experiment. The database will be stored as data/ftms_flax_neg.sqlite.

Create a new SQLite connection

# Create a new SQLite database connection (file will be created if it doesn't exist)
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/ftms_flax_neg.sqlite")

##Create table experiment to store experiment metadata

#new_exp_id <- max(dbReadTable(con, "experiment")$expid, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS experiment (
    expid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,  -- auto-incrementing ID
    date TEXT,
    user TEXT,
    machine TEXT,
    column TEXT,
    mstype TEXT,
    buffera TEXT,
    bufferb TEXT,
    gradient_time TEXT,
    source TEXT,
    mode TEXT,
    species TEXT,
    tissue TEXT,
    ce TEXT,
    meta TEXT
  );
")
[1] 0

##Insert Experiment data to Experiment table

dbExecute(con, "
  INSERT INTO experiment 
    (date, user, machine, column, mstype, buffera, bufferb, gradient_time, source, mode, species, tissue, ce, meta)
  VALUES 
    ('2025-10-28', 'Ahlam', 'FTMS', NULL, 'FTMS', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'neg', NULL, 'seed', NULL, NULL);
")
[1] 1

##Create table ms_compound to store compounds information

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ms_compound (
    compound_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    expid INTEGER,
    nodename TEXT,
    retention_time REAL,
    mass_measured REAL,
    name TEXT,
    formula TEXT,
    exactmass REAL,
    ppm_deviation REAL,
    subsid INTEGER,
    conversion TEXT,
    wavelen REAL,
    smiles TEXT,
    isotope_ratio REAL,
    drift_time REAL,
    composition TEXT,
    inchi TEXT,
    inchikey TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (expid) REFERENCES experiment(expid)
  );
")

Insert data to the compound table

# Convert Spectra DFrame to a normal data.frame
sp_df <- as.data.frame(sp_data)

# Keep unique features with valid mz and rt
cmp <- sp_df %>%
  select(feature_id, feature_rtmed, feature_mzmed) %>%
  filter(!is.na(feature_id),
         !is.na(feature_rtmed),
         !is.na(feature_mzmed)) %>%
  distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

n <- nrow(cmp)


last_id <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT MAX(CAST(compound_id AS INTEGER)) AS max_id
    FROM ms_compound;
")$max_id

start_id <- if (is.na(last_id)) 1 else last_id + 1
last_expid <- tail(dbReadTable(con, "experiment")$expid, 1)

# Build final dataframe
ms_compound_df <- data.frame(
  compound_id     = as.character(seq(start_id, length.out = n)),
  expid           = rep(last_expid, n),
  nodename        = cmp$feature_id,
  retention_time  = cmp$feature_rtmed,
  mass_measured   = cmp$feature_mzmed,
  name = NA_character_,
  formula = NA_character_,
  exactmass = NA_real_,
  ppm_deviation = NA_real_,
  subsid = NA_integer_,
  conversion = NA_character_,
  wavelen = NA_real_,
  smiles = NA_character_,
  isotope_ratio = NA_real_,
  drift_time = NA_real_,
  composition = NA_character_,
  inchi = NA_character_,
  inchikey = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
#Insert ms_compound table 
dbWriteTable(con, "ms_compound", ms_compound_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
#Verification
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM ms_compound LIMIT 10;")

Verify if there is duplicated nodename

dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT compound_id, retention_time, nodename
  FROM ms_compound
  WHERE expid = 1
    AND nodename IN (
        SELECT nodename
        FROM ms_compound
        WHERE expid = 1
        GROUP BY nodename
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
  ORDER BY nodename
  "
)

#Create msms_spectrum table

# Drop old table
dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS msms_spectrum;")
[1] 0
# Force all numeric columns in msms_spectrum to REAL
dbExecute(con, "
CREATE TABLE msms_spectrum (
  spectrum_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  compound_id TEXT,
  ms_level INTEGER,
  polarity INTEGER,
  spectrum_type TEXT,
  precursor_mz REAL,
  precursorIntensity REAL,
  precursorCharge INTEGER,
  collision_energy TEXT,
  isolationWindowLowerMz REAL,
  isolationWindowTargetMz REAL,
  isolationWindowUpperMz REAL,
  peaks_count INTEGER,
  totIonCurrent REAL,
  basePeakMZ REAL,
  basePeakIntensity REAL,
  ionisationEnergy REAL,
  lowMZ REAL,
  highMZ REAL,
  mergedScan INTEGER,
  mergedResultScanNum INTEGER,
  mergedResultStartScanNum INTEGER,
  mergedResultEndScanNum INTEGER,
  injectionTime REAL,
  filterString TEXT,
  spectrumId INTEGER,
  ionMobilityDriftTime REAL,
  scanWindowLowerLimit REAL,
  scanWindowUpperLimit REAL,
  electronBeamEnergy REAL,
  originalPrecursorMz REAL,
  precursorPurity REAL,
  chromPeakRT REAL,
  chromPeakMz REAL,
  chromPeakId TEXT,
  rtime REAL,
  scanIndex INTEGER,
  dataStorage TEXT,
  centroided INTEGER,
  smoothed INTEGER,
  instrument TEXT,
  splash TEXT,
  instrument_type TEXT,
  acquisitionNum INTEGER,
  precScanNum INTEGER,
  predicted REAL,
  dataOrigin TEXT,
  original_id TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (compound_id) REFERENCES ms_compound(compound_id)
);
")

insert spectra data to the msms_spectrum table

sp <- spectraData(ftms_all)

getcol <- function(x) if (x %in% names(sp)) sp[[x]] else NA

##Create msms_spectrum_peak table

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msms_spectrum_peak (
    peak_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    spectrum_id INTEGER,
    mz REAL,
    intensity REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (spectrum_id) REFERENCES msms_spectrum(spectrum_id)
  );
")
[1] 0

##insert each individual peak in a single row

pd <- peaksData(ftms_all)

# Flatten peaks list into a data frame
peaks_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(pd), function(i) {
    if (!is.null(pd[[i]]) && nrow(pd[[i]]) > 0) {
      data.frame(
        spectrum_id = i,  # corresponds to row order in msms_spectrum
        mz = pd[[i]][, 1],
        intensity = pd[[i]][, 2]
      )
    }
  })
)

head(peaks_df)

dbWriteTable(con, "msms_spectrum_peak", peaks_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

    nodename TEXT,
    dataOrigin TEXT,
    Value REAL,
    expid INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (expid) REFERENCES experiment(expid)
  );
")

matrix_to_long <- function(feature_values) {
  feature_values %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -feature_id,
      names_to = "dataOrigin",
      values_to = "Value"
    )
}
